Describe the user-facing correction or improvement.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] This changes only allowlisted public documentation or issue forms; it does not change `CODEOWNERS`, the public-boundary workflow, or the release public key.
- [ ] It contains no Nulx product source, build files, binaries, archives, ISO, Git LFS pointer, or submodule.
- [ ] It contains no credentials, private keys, internal paths, private repository information, raw logs, or personal data.
- [ ] All claims describe verified public behavior and do not announce an unreleased ISO or feature.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported privately instead of included here.
